T: Find the glow. Then find the dumplings.
D: A young martial artist in Harlem searches for the master who can teach him the final level.
P: Serve dinner when Leroy eats popcorn with chopsticks at the cinema.
S: Stovetop popcorn tossed in melted butter and salt
Popcorn tossed in melted butter with furikake and a pinch of sugar. Serve with chopsticks and see who gives up first.
Crisp rolls filled with cabbage, carrot, shiitake and glass noodles
Shredded cabbage, carrot, shiitake and glass noodles stir-fried with soy and white pepper, cooled, rolled tight in spring roll pastry, fried at 180C. Sweet chilli.
M: Fortune cookie factory chicken lo mein
fresh egg noodles wok-tossed with chicken, bean sprouts, spring onion and oyster sauce

Fresh egg noodles tossed in a smoking wok with chicken, bean sprouts, spring onion and oyster sauce. Slice 500g chicken thigh, toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Blanch 500g fresh egg noodles 1 minute and drain. Stir-fry the chicken in a smoking wok with 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 1 sliced carrot and 200g bean sprouts for 1 minute, then noodles, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 2 minutes and finish with spring onions.
Crispy fried chicken thigh in a sweet, spicy soy and dried chilli sauce
Chicken thigh chunks in potato starch batter, double-fried, tossed in a sauce of dried chilli, garlic, ginger, soy, black vinegar, sugar and stock. Rice.
W: Soft coconut rice dough wrapped around mango and whipped cream
Glutinous rice flour, sugar and coconut milk steamed into dough, wrapped around cubes of mango and whipped cream, dusted in cornflour.
thin vanilla wafers baked in circles and folded around a paper message while hot
Thin vanilla batter spread in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around a fortune while hot.
K: Chilled chrysanthemum flower tea, lightly sweet with rock sugar
Steep dried chrysanthemum flowers with a little rock sugar for 5 minutes, chill and serve over ice.

dishes.make_ahead: Pop the corn up to 4 hours ahead and keep it airtight; toss with the butter, furikake and sugar just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot with three kernels and cover.
When they pop, add the rest of the kernels, cover and shake until the popping slows.
Toss with the melted butter, furikake and sugar. Hand out chopsticks.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 1 day ahead, chilled; roll up to 4 hours ahead under a damp cloth and fry just before serving

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water, then drain.
Stir-fry the cabbage, grated carrot and sliced shiitake with the noodles, soy and white pepper. Cool.
Roll tightly in the wrappers, sealing with water.
Fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches. Serve with sweet chilli.

dishes.make_ahead: Dice the chicken up to 1 day ahead, chilled, and mix the sauce up to 2 days ahead; coat, fry and toss on the night

steps.text: Dice the chicken and toss in the potato starch.
Start the rice and cook until fluffy.
Fry the chicken in 180C oil in batches, drain, then fry a second time until crisp.
Fry the chillies, crushed garlic and grated ginger in a hot wok, then add soy, vinegar, sugar and stock.
Toss the chicken through the sauce and serve over rice.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cube the tofu up to 1 day ahead, chilled, and mix the sauce up to 2 days ahead; coat, fry and toss on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into 2cm cubes and toss in the potato starch.
Start the rice and cook until fluffy.
Fry the tofu in 180C oil in batches, drain, then fry a second time until crisp.
Fry the chillies, crushed garlic and grated ginger in a hot wok, then add soy, vinegar, sugar and stock.
Toss the tofu through the sauce and serve over rice.
Mix the rice flour, sugar and coconut milk until smooth and pour into a heatproof bowl.
Steam, stirring halfway, until thick and translucent.
Dust a board with cornflour, tip out the dough and divide it into pieces.
Wrap each piece around a cube of mango and a spoonful of whipped cream.
Chill until set.
Steep the flowers and rock sugar in just-boiled water.
Strain, cool and chill well in the fridge.
Pour over ice in tall glasses and float a flower or two on top.

s.note: Stovetop popcorn tossed in melted butter and salt
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot with 3 kernels. When they pop, add 120g kernels, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter, 3 tbsp furikake and a pinch of sugar. Hand out chopsticks and see who gives up first.

s.note: Crisp rolls filled with cabbage, carrot, shiitake and glass noodles
s.how: Stir-fry 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot and 100g sliced shiitake. Add 50g soaked glass noodles, soy and white pepper, then cool. Roll tightly in 16 spring roll wrappers, sealing with water, and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with sweet chilli.

m.note: Crispy fried chicken thigh in a sweet, spicy soy and dried chilli sauce
m.how: Toss 800g diced chicken thighs in 100g potato starch and fry twice at 180C. Fry 8 dried chillies, 3 garlic cloves and ginger, then add 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 3 tbsp sugar and 125ml stock. Toss the chicken through. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Soft coconut rice dough wrapped around mango and whipped cream
w.how: Mix 150g glutinous rice flour, 50g sugar and 200ml coconut milk, then steam for 20 minutes, stirring halfway. Dust a board with cornflour and divide into 8. Wrap each around a cube of mango and a spoon of whipped cream. Chill 30 minutes.

d.note: Chilled chrysanthemum flower tea, lightly sweet with rock sugar
d.how: Steep 15g dried chrysanthemum flowers in 1L just-boiled water with 50g rock sugar for 5 minutes. Strain, cool and chill well in the fridge. Pour over ice in four tall glasses and float a flower or two on top.
